title: rubus villicaulis subsp. melanoxylon
intro: Rubus villicaulis subsp. melanoxylon, commonly known as the Himalayan Black Raspberry or Black Himalayan Raspberry, is a species of flowering plant in the rose family. It is native to the Himalayas and has been traditionally used in Ayurvedic medicine for its various health benefits. The plant has been reported to possess antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial properties, which contribute to its therapeutic actions such as wound healing, pain relief, and antimicrobial activities. The bioactive constituents of Rubus villicaulis subsp. melanoxylon include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and anthocyanins, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
